"""RoboLab limited-mode control record for apple_and_yogurt_in_bowl."""
import json
import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()

def observe(tag="obs", depth=True):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video="frames")
    os.makedirs("/app/output/observations", exist_ok=True)
    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/observations/{tag}_{cam}.jpg", quality=95)
    if depth:
        for cam, d in obs.last_depth.items():
            np.save(f"/app/output/observations/{tag}_{cam}_depth.npy", d)
    print("proprio now:", obs.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now"))
    print("time left:", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"))
    return obs

def move_ee(pose, gripper=None, note=""):
    """Single Cartesian target [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz], retaining current gripper unless set."""
    g = float(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][7] > 0.04) if gripper is None else float(gripper)
    a = np.asarray([list(pose[:7]) + [g]], dtype=np.float32)
    out = r.submit("ee_pose", a, video="frames", note=note)
    print("move:", out.meta)
    return out

def move_joint(q, gripper=None, dt=0.2, note=""):
    g = float(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][7] > 0.04) if gripper is None else float(gripper)
    a = np.asarray([list(q[:7]) + [g]], dtype=np.float32)
    out = r.submit("joint_position", a, dt=dt, video="frames", note=note)
    print("move:", out.meta)
    return out

def save_result(out, tag):
